function.name: read_status
function.description: Read released current ship, cargo, mission, time and event state. Does not grant resume permission.

function.name: read_reports
function.description: Read issued reports applicable to the current and neighbouring sectors. Never exposes raw future fields.

function.name: request_decision
function.description: Keep the game paused and return the player decision context. Never resumes automatically.

function.name: advance
function.description: Follow the already validated player order until a local checkpoint, manual pause or terminal outcome. Requires live player resume authorization. Call exactly once.

function.name: finish_mission
function.description: Return and preserve an existing terminal outcome. Fails if the mission has not ended. No simulation advancement.

function.name: manage_attention
function.description: Choose delivery of already issued report IDs and optionally request a player decision based on current evidence. Never advances or changes the ship order.
